generator: three.js WebGLRenderer render of public/models/<form>.glb in rest pose via run/view/assets.ts loadFormModel (facing +Z), headless Chrome
camera: PerspectiveCamera 28 deg, slightly right of centre, about 10 deg above; hemisphere + ambient + key light; transparent background
processing: trim to alpha bounds, fit 304 px, centre on 320x320, WebP q86
purpose: Evolution-chain portraits; the four base starters now use starters.provenance.json.
rerendered: 2026-11-06: pikachu and raichu from their regenerated models (the old pikachu portrait showed the old model's blue eyes)
rights: Rendered from the project's own Tripo models of a noncommercial Pokemon fan project; character designs belong to their rights holders.
